resources.string: For this voice note, TieComs will send the audio and language to Inworld for transcription. DeepSeek will receive the transcript, author and participant names, and conversation name to suggest a summary and issues. These external services process that content. You can continue without AI: the voice note will still be sent and playable.

For this summary, TieComs will send the sidechat messages, participant names, original message and author, group name, and your name to DeepSeek. This external service processes that content to suggest a summary. You can continue without AI and edit the text yourself.
